description: Rename multiple clips on the timeline using a pattern. Supports sequential numbering.

pattern.description: Name pattern. Use {n} for a sequential number, ## for a zero-padded two-digit sequence number, and {name} for the original name (e.g., 'Scene_##', '{name}_v2')

selected_only.description: Only rename selected clips (default: false, renames all on track)

track_type.description: Track type to rename clips on

name: batch_rename_clips

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Batch Rename Clips
